# Synthetic inspection review procedure

SYNTHETIC FIXTURE ONLY. This document is not API 570 and is not an approved engineering SOP. It contains no acceptance limits or authoritative formulas.

## Section 1 Source verification

For each inspection thickness reading, retain the asset tag, original thickness value and unit, source report page and a short source quote. Verify extracted pressure against the source. A model confidence score does not replace source verification.

## Section 2 Missing engineering rules

When approved minimum thickness, safety factor rules, remaining life rules or the governing standard edition are missing, record engineering review required. Do not infer a pass, fail or approval verdict from these synthetic pages.

## Section 3 Draft review note

The inspection review note must distinguish extracted observations, descriptive calculations and retrieved evidence. A reviewer must confirm the source readings before any operating decision.
